newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Trade in Top Glory shares suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trade in Top Glory shares suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of Top Glory International Holdings Ltd was suspended at the company's request pending an announcement, the Hong Kong Stock Exchange said on Monday.

Top Glory said in January it was in talks to purchase Chinese hotel interests from its controlling shareholder, but that no decision had been made to proceed with such acquisitions or on the timing and terms.
The company's shares closed unchanged at HK$1.89 on Friday.
Top Glory, which is indirectly controlled by China-backed China National Cereals Oil and Foodstuffs Import and Export Corp (Ceroil), is involved in property investment and food related businesses.
